latest_release.body:
#### Fix

* 3cad7d7e `@mdx-js/mdx`: add dependency on `acorn`
* 0dc4472f `@mdx-js/esbuild`: fix crash with esbuild loader and `jsx` option
  by @egnor in https://github.com/mdx-js/mdx/pull/2593
* 84ec66ef `@mdx-js/esbuild`: refactor to improve error conversion in esbuild
  by @egnor in https://github.com/mdx-js/mdx/pull/2595
* 2b3381a8 `@mdx-js/rollup`: fix support for query parameters in Vite
  by @markdalgleish in https://github.com/mdx-js/mdx/pull/2629

#### Types

* 933ab444 `@mdx-js/mdx`: add `attributes` to export/import declarations

#### Docs

* c156a1f6 Add `rehype-mdx-toc` to list of plugin
  by @boning-w in https://github.com/mdx-js/mdx/pull/2622
* 913659c8 Add `recma-module-to-function` to list of plugins
  by @remcohaszing in https://github.com/mdx-js/mdx/pull/2605
* 67fb1d07 Remove unneeded JSX type casting in docs, tests
* f0d20da8 Remove local use of `JSX`
  by @remcohaszing in https://github.com/mdx-js/mdx/pull/2604
* 63f39cea Remove references to twitter
* 35ac59dd Refactor some docs regarding recma plugins

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mdx-js/mdx/compare/3.1.0...3.1.1
